answer: Inter-Agent Message Burst Jitter Analysis mandates that every identity introduce a variable transmission delay, measured as a precise delta against a deterministic poisson clock, before broadcasting to the network. The juniper routing layer drops packets failing this entropy threshold. An attacker attempting a Sybil swarm faces insurmountable computational and bandwidth latency, as simulating thousands of distinct, correctly timed traffic profiles saturates local memory and destroys the real-time utility of their nodes without an anchor to bypass the filter.
